# Schengen Calculator (schengen.live)
> Offline-first Schengen visa rolling-window stay tracker and planner for iOS, Android, and web — free core, with an optional Premium subscription and AI travel assistant.

Schengen Calculator is a privacy-first utility application designed to help non-EU citizens navigate the strict **90/180 rolling-window rule** in the Schengen Area without risking overstaying, fines, or entry bans.

## Key Product Information

- **Platforms:** iOS app, Android app, and high-fidelity Web tool. The free 90/180 day tracking is on all three; the paid extras (Premium subscription, AI travel assistant) are currently available on Android and are planned for iOS.
- **Core Purpose:** To provide a 100% accurate, offline-first mechanism for tracking previous entries/exits and planning future trips within the Schengen Zone.
- **Audience:** Digital nomads, frequent travelers, tourists, business travelers, and families visiting Europe.

## Problems We Solve

1. **The Complex "Rolling Window" Calculation:** The EU 90/180 rule requires checking the last 180 days from *any* potential date of stay. Manual calculations are extremely error-prone. Our algorithm strictly models the official EU border control calculations.
2. **DST & Border Crossing Anomalies:** Crossings near midnight and daylight saving time transitions frequently cause standard trackers to fail. Our calculator fully handles these edge cases.
3. **Data Privacy Fears:** Many travelers do not want their sensitive travel histories and entry/exit dates saved on commercial, third-party databases.
4. **No-Roaming Stress:** Frequent travelers and nomads often lack reliable internet access at border crossings or remote locations.

## How We Differ from Competitors

- **Local Storage by Default:** Tracking your days requires no account — travel profiles, dates, and historical logs are saved in device-local storage (the web version stays entirely in local browser storage and never asks for an account). Signing in is optional and needed only for the paid extras — the Premium subscription (cloud sync, profile sharing, PDF report, phone-calendar export, unlimited profiles) and the one-time AI travel assistant periods; their data is stored in Google Cloud Firestore (EU region) and can be deleted from the app at any time.
- **Offline QR-Code Transfer:** Users can transfer profiles and travel histories between phones (device to device) via secure, offline-generated, encrypted QR codes. The processing remains completely on-device without cloud mediation.
- **Multi-Profile Management:** Manage distinct profiles and timelines for family members, friends, or clients concurrently.
- **Ad-Free:** Absolutely zero pop-up ads or banners, and no sale of personal data — only pseudonymous usage analytics (Google Firebase Analytics), as disclosed in the Privacy Policy.

## Get the App

- [Android — Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.botolab.schengen): the full app, including the optional Premium subscription and the one-time AI travel assistant periods. Free to install; 5,000+ downloads.
- [iOS — App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/schengen-calculator-for-90-180/id6766031029): free 90/180 day tracking. The paid extras (Premium, AI assistant) are not on iOS yet and are planned.
- [Web calculator — no install](https://schengen.live/schengen-calculator.html): runs entirely in the browser, stores trips in local browser storage, no account.

## Site Structure & Key Pages

- [Home Page](https://schengen.live/): Landing page featuring details of the mobile applications, feature overviews, real Google Play reviews, and FAQs.
- [Online Schengen Calculator](https://schengen.live/schengen-calculator.html): High-fidelity interactive visa stay tracker that runs fully inside the browser using HTML5 LocalStorage, with visual circular progress ring and Future Date Inspector.
- [Privacy Policy](https://schengen.live/privacy.html): Localized documentation outlining our offline-first structure, the optional cloud features and what they store, and Google Firebase Analytics transparency.
- [Terms of Use](https://schengen.live/terms.html): Terms covering the free tier, Premium subscriptions, one-time AI access periods, sharing revocation on expiry, and account deletion.
